The '''Jentares system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] lit by a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]].

The system was home to the reclusive [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Siolo Ur Manka]]. It was here that he was [[Duels in the Jentares system|ambushed]] and killed by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] on the orders of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].
